task: Write a crawl-stats module: run_crawl(urls) fans fetch work out on a ThreadPoolExecutor with about twenty workers; each worker calls record_hit(url, nbytes), which updates the module-level hits dict and total_bytes counter; report() returns the current numbers.

constraints.text: hits and total_bytes only change inside a with-lock block on a shared threading.Lock
constraints.why: lost increments under twenty threads made the 2026-03 crawl report 12 percent low; the unlocked += read-modify-write interleaved

checks.description: no lock created for shared counters
counter updates not wrapped in a with-lock block

constraints.text: the executor runs as a context manager (or gets an explicit shutdown) so every worker finishes before report() reads
constraints.why: the 2025-10 job printed totals while eight workers were still writing; two consecutive report calls in the same log disagreed

checks.description: executor never joined (no with block, no shutdown)

constraints.text: report() hands back copies of the counters, not the live dict
constraints.why: iterating the live dict during the 2026-03 run raised RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration inside the metrics exporter
